 Coram:
Justice Sashikanta Mishra
Order_ 14.11.2023 Order No. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Gania P.S. Case No. 43 of 2020 corresponding to Special GR Case No. 84 of 2023 pending in the court of learned ADJ-cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act, Nayagarh.
4.
Though the principal accused has been forwarded under Section 376(3) and allied offences, there is no allegation as such against the present petitioner more so under Section 376(3) of IPC.

As such,
the anticipatory bail application is held to be maintainable in so far as the petitioner is concerned.

5. Having regard to the absence of allegations against the petitioner, while not being inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to surrender before the court below within a week from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, he shall be released on bail on such terms and condition as the court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
6. The ABLAPL is disposed of.
7. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
